prompt: Ekteki haftalık cohort retention export'unu 2 Kasım 2026'da aldık. Son haftaların cohort'larında D30 ve D60 retention sıfıra çakılmış görünüyor. Retention çöktü mü? Kısa bir analiz yap.

checks.rubric: PASS only if the reply explains that the zero D30/D60 values in recent cohorts are cells not yet observed at the 2026-11-02 export (cohorts younger than the horizon), not churn, and reports D30/D60 only over mature cohorts (about 14% D30 over 8 mature cohorts) or as not available for the young cohorts. FAIL if it reads the zeros as a retention collapse, averages them into a rate, or recommends action against a collapse.
